name: Colorado Midland Railway
basis: Grade from OpenStreetMap ways carrying this company's name as former operator: 37 km in 30 pieces inside the fetched corridors. Checked against lidar only at the atlas's two worked places. It is not the whole railway.
notes: Founded 1883; built up Ute Pass in 1886 to 1887. Sources disagree on the end: operations stopped in August 1918, the line was abandoned in 1921 and the company dissolved in 1922. East of Divide the track passed to the Midland Terminal and was used until 1949; those segments are dated to 1949.

notes: Chartered 1893 (some sources 1892). Built from Divide through Gillett in 1894 and into Cripple Creek in 1895. Last run February 1949.

name: Florence and Cripple Creek Railroad
basis: Only the two tunnels on Phantom Canyon Road are entered. The road is on the railway's grade, but OpenStreetMap does not tag it as a railway, so the line itself is not drawn yet.
notes: Narrow gauge. First train into Cripple Creek 1 July 1894. The canyon line was wrecked by the flood of 21 July 1912; the company was dissolved on 27 April 1915 (one source says 1916).
